source_summary: Lower portion of the hanging scroll contains an ink-and-light-wash landscape: mist-filled rocky mountains rise in the midground, smaller hillocks dissolve into fog, and the foreground opens into wooded riverbanks, paths, fields, boats, and a small riverside settlement. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and blank paper areas are excluded.

motifs.name: central_misty_peak_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the main group of tall rounded mountains in the upper landscape area, including the dark central peak, flanking pale peaks, clustered crags, and the mist that softens their bases.
must_preserve: dense hemp-fiber and dot texture on peak crowns
soft vertical ink washes down rock faces
dark tree-dot silhouettes along ridgelines
pale mist edges cutting through the mountain bases
subtle tonal separation between nearer dark peaks and receding pale peaks

motifs.name: lower_mist_hillocks
motifs.description: Isolate the chain of small rounded hilltops emerging from fog beneath the main mountains, including scattered dark caps and low ink-washed mounds.
must_preserve: rounded island-like hill silhouettes
dark stippled brush crowns on hilltops
soft blurred lower edges disappearing into mist
thin gradations of gray wash
irregular spacing of small peaks across the fog bank

motifs.name: right_distant_mist_islets
motifs.description: Isolate the faint low hills and tiny rocky islets on the right side of the misty middle distance, set in a broad open fog field.
must_preserve: very pale ink silhouettes of far hills
tiny dark rock tips breaking the mist surface
soft horizontal fog transitions
minimal sparse brush marks
empty atmospheric spacing around the forms

motifs.name: left_foreground_cliff_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the large dark rocky cliff at the lower left with attached trees, shrubs, and cascading vertical vegetation lines along its face.
must_preserve: bold dark ink mass of the cliff face
wrinkled rock contour lines and crevice strokes
dense leaf-dot clusters on the cliff top and sides
thin hanging vegetation or root-like vertical strokes
small pale openings and wash highlights within the rock

motifs.name: lower_left_riverside_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the wooded riverbank below the left cliff, including dense trunks, leafy canopies, shrubs, rocks, and the curved shoreline at the water edge.
must_preserve: closely packed tree trunks with fine linework
varied leaf-dot textures and rounded foliage clusters
bare twig branches mixed with leafy trees
curving ink shoreline and low rocks
soft wash transition from bank into open water

motifs.name: small_scholar_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat in the lower left-center water with tiny seated figures and oar or pole strokes, keeping only the immediate water around it.
must_preserve: slender boat hull drawn with fine contour lines
tiny human figures seated or leaning within the boat
delicate oar or pole strokes
small dark accent marks defining heads and garments
surrounding pale water left mostly unpainted

motifs.name: central_grove_path_knoll
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground grove and low knoll, including clustered trees, a winding path or bank line, shrubs, and small rocks leading toward the valley.
must_preserve: interlaced tree trunks and branches
mixed dark and pale foliage dots
curving path or riverbank contour lines
low rounded knoll with light wash texture
small rocks and shrub accents at the grove base

motifs.name: right_riverside_boat_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side riverside settlement area with bamboo or tree grove, low pavilion-like structures, moored boats, reeds, and adjacent shoreline.
must_preserve: thin roof and railing geometry of the small waterside structures
clustered boat hulls with fine linear strokes
vertical bamboo or tree trunks behind the bank
reed-like grasses along the shoreline
pale water channels and soft bank washes around the hamlet

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
